purpose: Recompute ALL 47 already-observed independent Bybit Spot 4h MR40+Momentum30 completed LONG next-open pairs, with explicit gross and 2026 Bybit public tier Spot two-sided taker fees; never claim fills, live execution, unseen OOS or account-specific rates.

public_fee_source.fact: Bybit regular crypto-crypto Spot VIP0 taker .1000%/side; VIP3 taker .0750%/side. Actual regional/VIP account rates are UNKNOWN, do not claim measured actual account fees.

account_model.entry_exit_prices: only frozen same-market OHLCV 4h next open for signal boundaries; not order fills
account_model.scope: All 47 pairs, same count and dates for ALL three fee scenarios; train/eval separately plus chronological full combined. Max drawdown computed only on CLOSED-TRADE equity curve, not mark-to-market intra-trade or time underwater.
account_model.fixed_notional_comparison: Separately compute per trade fixed 500 quote net markout and sum without compounding; this is NOT an account balance simulation; compounded curve is account illustrative, both source prices are not proven executable.
account_model.limitations: No trade-specific L2 spread/book at 47 entry/exits, no actual fee tier verification, slippage, volatility or latency distribution; zero fee scenario is mathematical upper bound conditional on assumed Open prices; all history used previously, not genuinely unseen strategy edge.
